notes.title: Cockhero Battle Rookie: Patch 1.12 Update
notes.notes:
----- Patch 1.12 Update -----


 This update includes Small Bug Fixes and Performance Improvements that greatly compounds to the overall quality of life in the game.
 Character has been Updated with ornaments.
 Menu and settings has been updated.
 The backend of Character creation menu has been revamped.

notes.title: ----- Patch 1.11 -----
notes.notes:
----- Patch 1.11 Major Update ----- 

[olist]
 Major Overhaul in Graphics and Gameplay.
 Major Memory Leak issues fixed.
 Fixed Crashing Issues reported where the game crashes after exiting Character Customizer Window.
 Game Fixed on low end devices. Major Stutters and Lags are Mostly Fixed.
 Added New Assets in the level.
 The Character Customizer UI has been updated. Now the player can customize the character more easily.
 Mirrors which created more stutters in Update 1.04 have now been fixed. Please refer to the Minimum System Requirements to get the best Performance. Get it here

 More Story Dialogues are Added.
 Textures are Remapped and reduced in size with little to no quality reduction.
[/olist]

notes.title: Version 1.0.3 Update Advent of Character Customizer
notes.notes:
------ Version 1.0.3 Update ------

------ Advent of Character Customizer ------



 The character customizer has been into development for a while. Now it's ready and fully functional to customize your Sugar Mommy and give her a new look. A large variety of clothes and outfits have been added to her wardrobe. The player will be able to customize her dressing style as per his likings. Both medievial styled outfits and modern outfits have been made ready to work with the character.

 Some New settings have been modified which earlier created issues of memory leaks.

 Added an fps counter to test the fps through and ingame overlay meter. Now the player could monitor the fps ingame without any external software.

 Added the ability to remove all clothes ingame. The player can also expose off her dick too while in game.

 Hairs and Fabrics of the players are modified from the previous versions.

 A new hair customizer is in works lately and will be updated in the near future. Till then, stay GOONED....

notes.title: Update Version 1.0.2

- Added Physics based Doors where needed
